title: Floor is Lava Challenge
description: Mod that makes you die when you stand on a block type other than the one you spawned on.
body:
This simple mod adds a "the floor is lava"-style challenge to the game:

When you spawn, the block you are standing on is recorded.
If you ever step onto a different type of block, you are instantly killed.

For example, if you spawn on grass, walking onto dirt or stone will kill you.

<details>
<summary>Cheese Trick</summary>
Note that you can cheese the mechanic a little bit by leaping over to a new block type and quitting the game in midair, since the "spawn block" is not saved.
</details>

The mod is public domain and extremely simple. Feel free to make your own variant! The project sources are released in a ZIP file alongside the mod release.
